fix_commit.message: Range check the column index on the sqlite3_preupdate_old() interface and return SQLITE_MISUSE if too large. [forum:/forumpost/b617e497287235d0|Forum post b617e49728].
fix_commit.author: drh

findings.title: Missing range check on column index before calling sqlite3TableColumnToStorage() in sqlite3_preupdate_old()
findings.message: sqlite3_preupdate_old() takes a caller-supplied column index `iIdx` and, when the table has no rowid alias handled via pPk, passes it directly to sqlite3TableColumnToStorage(p->pTab, iIdx) without first verifying that `iIdx` is within `[0, p->pTab->nCol)`. sqlite3TableColumnToStorage() only guards this precondition with `assert(iCol<pTab->nCol)`, which is compiled out in release (NDEBUG) builds. If `iIdx` is out of range (e.g. called with a value >= the number of columns in the table, which any application using the preupdate hook API can pass), the function's loop `for(i=0,n=0;i<iCol;i++){ if(... pTab->aCol[i] ...) }` followed by `pTab->aCol[i].colFlags` reads past the end of the `pTab->aCol[]` array, causing an out-of-bounds read of table metadata. This can leak adjacent heap memory contents through the returned column value or crash the process. The commit that introduced this exact call path (replacing the previous direct use of `iIdx` with a call through sqlite3TableColumnToStorage) failed to add the necessary bounds check that had previously been implicit, creating an unchecked array index vulnerability reachable from the public sqlite3_preupdate_old() API.
findings.suggestion: Before calling sqlite3TableColumnToStorage(p->pTab, iIdx) (and likewise in sqlite3_preupdate_new()), explicitly validate that iIdx is within [0, p->pTab->nCol) and return SQLITE_MISUSE_BKPT (or SQLITE_RANGE) immediately if not, rather than relying on the callee's debug-only assertion.

ground_truth.root_cause: A refactor introduced a call to sqlite3TableColumnToStorage(), a helper whose safety contract requires the caller to pre-validate the column index against pTab->nCol (enforced only via a debug assert), without adding that validation at the call site in the public preupdate API. The caller (sqlite3_preupdate_old) incorrectly assumed the callee would perform range checking, while the callee assumed the caller already had.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: Missing range check on column index before calling sqlite3TableColumnToStorage() in sqlite3_preupdate_old()
